subject: [hw] DEC06 -> opus-ios/IP/lead2: the decoder plug-in artifact for the decode payload (file, switches, build objects, expected console lines)
body:
For whenever decode goes into a rootfs payload. Ready on the tree; nothing has been run on a phone.

Artifact: one dylib FILE, /System/Library/VideoDecoders/Slim.videodecoder, entry symbol SLIMRegister (void(void), visibility default, verified exported in the arm64-apple-ios16.0 link). It is a separate file from Slim.videoencoder; deleting it disables decoding without touching recording (opus-dec3 two-dylib proposal).

Build objects (all in gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/, plus opus-mm21 mm21/n2_mm21.c):
  n2vtd_nal.c n2vtd_pixels.c n2vtd_client_proto.c n2vtd_client_dec05.c n2vtd_obj.c n2vtd_register.c n2vtd_log.c
  gpu/hwcodec/mm21/n2_mm21.c (libyuv-verified MM21->NV12 staged converter; the object falls back to its own if absent)
Link: P03 transport (client/n2vcd_transport.c) + DEC05 client (client/dec/n2vcd_dec.c, n2vcd_dec_path.c) once include/n2vcd_proto.h is rev 2; weak imports are fine (n2vcd_transport_*, n2vtd_client_dec05, n2vt_say), so a dylib without them still loads and reports the daemon unavailable. Include paths: -I gpu/video/include -I gpu/hwcodec/include -I gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec -I gpu/hwcodec/mm21 -I gpu/hwcodec/client/dec. Compile gpu/video/vt/n2vt_log.c too if you want console lines (recommended).

Switches (read once, when SLIMRegister runs):
  /private/var/db/nord2-video-hwdec            required for any registration
  /private/var/db/nord2-video-hwdec-no-hevc    avc1 only
  /private/var/db/nord2-video-off              vetoes everything (honour it in the installer too)
With the switch absent the plug-in registers nothing and VT keeps using Apple software decoders; with it present, CreateInstance does a 250 ms cached HELLO and returns -12913 if the daemon is unreachable, so VT falls through to H264SW/VCPHEVC.

Expected console lines on a successful load (through gpu/video n2vt_log; lines are prefixed "N2VIDEO <prog>[pid]:" by n2vt_say, and my text starts with "N2VDEC "):
  N2VDEC registered 2 hardware decoder(s) (avc1+hvc1)
  N2VDEC session start 61766331 320x240 stride 320 buf_h 256 MM21 video-range
  N2VDEC first picture pts=... 320x240
If the daemon is unreachable per codec: "N2VDEC avc1 decoder not offered: daemon unavailable, letting VT use its software decoder". If the switch is off: "N2VDEC not registered: switch files in /private/var/db say off". No line at all means the file was not dlopen-ed (the loader is silent about a missing file).

Sandbox: the plug-in runs in mediaserverd/VTDecoderXPCService and opens /dev/redwood-vcodec-client through P03 transport; if that open is denied there, it is a sandbox exception or a vcodecd relay decision, not a plug-in change. Worth checking on the first decode attempt.

No phone, nothing published.
